# Release Notes

## 0.40.0 — 2026-10-18

- Production release `0.40.0` is active on exact SHA `14b73b26f5562bb81619917dd0dafa17688395ae` (implementation PR `#39`, required main validation `39084085110`, approved production run `39084471797`, deployment evidence `readback: passed` at `2026-10-18T00:58:39.450078+00:00`). Admins can enter a manual partner code and positive trial days; new registrations receive that exact offer once, without card binding or auto-renew. Click-time terms and granted claims are snapshotted; changing days later does not rewrite existing grants. Partner terms take precedence over the separate legacy 90-day course UI. Focused backend tests and mobile browser acceptance passed. On production, a reversible synthetic check submitted a real admin form with 51 days, followed attribution into new-registration bootstrap, verified an exact 51-day subscription and authenticated onboarding, checked repeat entry, 137-day edits, rejected inactive/invalid/expired attribution, and verified rollback of synthetic data. All eight services are healthy; public PWA/helper return 200. External Telegram provider login and the owner's manual device test were not re-exercised; no card/payment/financial action was executed. Earlier receipt-quality/real-owner course acceptance gaps remain separate and unchanged. See `code/docs/releases/0.40.0-partner-trials.md`.
